scope.claim: development-only prevalence benchmark for real continuous backbone-ranking opportunity
scope.question: Across a predeclared matrix of 20 structured annotation targets in five image domains, how often does the best frozen nonlinear head materially outperform a linear ridge head and change the ranking of five frozen scout backbones?
scope.known_dataset_reuse: CUB, LSP, COCO, and Oxford-IIIT Pet datasets appeared in earlier experiments, but none of the 16 target channels defined here were previously evaluated; Pascal VOC and all four of its target channels are fresh
scope.future_gate: this benchmark measures availability of nonlinear ranking opportunity; it does not by itself validate an OverlapIndex ranker

source.pretraining_overlap_warning: the official source warns that CUB images overlap ImageNet

cub_200_2011_part_geometry.selection: target-specific deterministic SHA-256 order within ten equal-count target-rank strata; training replicates are disjoint

target_recipes.wing_axis_sine: y component of the unit vector from visible left-wing part 9 to visible right-wing part 13 in image coordinates
target_recipes.wing_axis_cosine: x component of the same unit wing vector
target_recipes.wing_span_over_bbox_diagonal: Euclidean distance between visible wing parts divided by the official bounding-box diagonal
target_recipes.leg_span_over_bbox_diagonal: Euclidean distance between visible left-leg part 8 and right-leg part 12 divided by the official bounding-box diagonal

lsp_2000_pose_geometry.split: images im0001-im1000 are training and im1001-im2000 are evaluation
lsp_2000_pose_geometry.visibility: LSP occlusion flag 0 is required for every joint used by a target
lsp_2000_pose_geometry.selection: target-specific deterministic SHA-256 order within ten equal-count target-rank strata; training replicates are disjoint

coco_2017_person_pose_geometry.split: COCO train2017 rows are training and val2017 rows are evaluation within the previously frozen 2044-image embedding cohort
coco_2017_person_pose_geometry.person_selection: largest-area finite non-crowd person annotation per image, tie-broken by annotation id
coco_2017_person_pose_geometry.visibility: COCO visibility code 2 is required for every joint used by a target
coco_2017_person_pose_geometry.selection: target-specific deterministic SHA-256 order within ten equal-count target-rank strata; training replicates are disjoint

oxford_iiit_pet_mask_geometry.split: reuse only evaluation plus training replicates 4103, 4201, and 4303 from the previously frozen mask cohort
oxford_iiit_pet_mask_geometry.foreground: official trimap values 1 and 3 are foreground/boundary; value 2 is background
oxford_iiit_pet_mask_geometry.perimeter: four-neighbor exposed-edge count including image boundaries
oxford_iiit_pet_mask_geometry.selection: within each already-disjoint split/replicate pool, deterministic SHA-256 order within ten equal-count target-rank strata

target_recipes.foreground_bbox_fill: foreground area divided by its tight axis-aligned bounding-box area
target_recipes.foreground_eccentricity: sqrt(1-lambda_min/lambda_max) from the foreground-pixel coordinate covariance
target_recipes.foreground_boundary_roughness: foreground perimeter divided by the perimeter of its tight bounding box

pascal_voc_2007_largest_box_geometry.split: official trainval is training and annotated official test is evaluation
pascal_voc_2007_largest_box_geometry.object_selection: largest-area non-difficult object per image using inclusive VOC coordinates, tie-broken by XML object order
pascal_voc_2007_largest_box_geometry.selection: target-specific deterministic SHA-256 order within ten equal-count target-rank strata; training replicates are disjoint

shared_pose_target_recipes.bilateral_elbow_extension_cosine: negative mean cosine between elbow-to-shoulder and elbow-to-wrist vectors; straight arms approach +1
shared_pose_target_recipes.wrist_span_over_torso_length: distance between wrists divided by distance between shoulder and hip midpoints
shared_pose_target_recipes.ankle_span_over_torso_length: distance between ankles divided by distance between shoulder and hip midpoints
shared_pose_target_recipes.shoulder_to_hip_width_ratio: distance between shoulders divided by distance between hips

cohort.shortfall_policy: fail closed before outcomes unless every target has 300 unique training rows and 200 evaluation rows

backbones.weights: exact cached pretrained checkpoint specifications already hash-locked by prior real-image panels

preprocessing.image: raw RGB image with each extractor's frozen native preprocessing
preprocessing.pca_fit_scope: training rows only per dataset, target, seed, and scout backbone

heads.selection: three-fold shuffled training-only GridSearchCV maximizing R2, followed by fixed-cohort evaluation

opportunity_definition.envelope: maximum held-out test R2 over the four frozen head families

admission.target_rule: all three base checks and at least one rank-change check must pass
admission.dataset_rule: at least one of four frozen targets passes
admission.benchmark_primary: report admitted target and dataset prevalence with Wilson 95% intervals; do not substitute targets after outcomes

reporting.runtime: head fitting time is descriptive and not a promotion criterion
reporting.pretraining_overlap: development-only because pretrained-source overlap cannot be excluded
